entities.summary: Munir Ahmed Dar was a Pakistani field hockey player who played as a fullback. He was a member of the Pakistan team that won gold at the 1960 Rome Olympics and silver at the 1956 Melbourne and 1964 Tokyo Olympics. He captained the side from 1965 to 1967.
